name: Asim Local
description: From Asim, the only province left to the Kings of Drinax — a minor agricultural world, low-tech and long-suffering. Prior to the reconquest the Asim were ruled by the cryptic Foundation; life has improved marginally for the peasants since then, but the planet is still a backwater.

traits.name: Agricultural World
traits.description: Asim is a low-tech farming world where hard work and resourcefulness are the only currencies that matter. Characters from Asim gain Animals 0 or Mechanic 0 as a free background skill. DM+1 on checks to evaluate food, crops, or trade goods for their true value.

traits.name: Foundation Shadow
traits.description: The cryptic Foundation once ruled Asim and their legacy lingers in whispered secrets and old loyalties. Asim locals begin play aware of Foundation rumours — the GM may use this as a plot hook. DM+1 to notice when someone is withholding information about the Foundation or its former activities.
